visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blonde-haired woman and a dark-haired man sit at a light-colored table in a modern interior with wooden shelves. A woman in a waitress uniform stands to the right. A man in a blue suit walks in from the left holding a white rectangular container. (2) The man in the blue suit slams his hand down onto an object wrapped in silver foil resting on a yellow substance. The couple at the table flinches and expresses shock with wide eyes and open mouths. (3) The waitress gestures for the couple to pay attention. The man in the blue suit shakes a container, sprinkling fine white powder over the table and the couple, who cover their faces with their hands and squint their eyes. (4) The waitress hands two small pieces of white paper to the couple. The man in the blue suit leans in close to the table and blows forcefully onto the food, causing the yellow substance and red liquid to splatter. (5) The man in the blue suit places green leaves onto the messy plate and begins a series of rhythmic, grand hand gestures, pointing his fingers and swaying his body. He then inserts several thin sticks into the center of the food pile. (6) The camera focuses on a close-up of the finished 'dish' which is a chaotic mix of yellow mash, red sauce, green leaves, and standing sticks. The man in the blue suit stands back with a proud posture. (7) The seated man stands up, pointing at the table with an angry facial expression and rapid mouth movements. The blonde woman looks at her empty hands and then at the man, appearing frantic and disappointed.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit parodying overly elaborate and 'special' food service at high-end restaurants. Through a series of increasingly absurd and messy 'culinary' actions performed by an eccentric waiter, the video mocks the pretentiousness of certain dining experiences, culminating in a frustrated realization by the patrons that they missed the chance to record the spectacle for social media.
